Name: The Horror of Loss
Information:
**The Horror of Loss**

The form of a family who had only each other, twisted by dark magic to fuse three sisters into one unholy beast. This creature, born from necromantic magic, lives in a state of blissful madness that removes the minds of its components (or what little remains of them) from having to consider the misery they could not stand alone. Such creatures can appear from similar attempts to escape mortality by fusing a living host with the body of departed loved ones (or forcefully restoring the souls of those who are dead, and binding them together in this bestial cage).

Stat Blocks.title: The Horror of Loss
languages: understands the languages of the creatures that constitute it, but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Dead Might (1/Day)
traits.description:
When the Horror would be reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright, its hit points are instead reset to 50 and it recovers from any condition(s) requiring an ongoing saving throw or with a duration of less than 1 hour. For 1 hour following the use of Dead Might, the Horror’s attacks have advantage, weapon attacks against it have advantage, and it is resistant to all bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

This effect ends early if the Horror begins its turn with 100 hit points or more.

traits.name: Tumultuous Leap
traits.description: The Horror can leap from a standing position to any space that is within its remaining movement speed, where it lands without taking falling damage. If it falls further, it takes half as much falling damage as it would normally and only considers the distance outside the initial space leaped.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Horror attacks twice with its Bold Savagery, then uses its Unending Lament.

actions.name: Bold Savagery
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d12 + 5) slashing damage, and the Horror’s choice of either 9 (2d8) necrotic damage or 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Unending Lament
actions.description: The Horror targets one creature within 60 feet of it, and psychically forces the anguish that brought about the Horror’s creation onto them. The target must succeed a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 20 (3d12) psychic damage and be made sluggish until the end of their next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Painful Memories
bonus_actions.description: The Horror conjures up the trauma of one of its component minds, and materializes the emotions tied to that beast as a supernatural effect. It rolls a d4, and produces the resulting effect:

options.name: A Mourning Sniper
options.description: The Horror produces spines that fire from its body at two creatures of its choice within 60 feet, who each must succeed a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage.

options.name: A Gentle Sister
options.description: The Horror is resistant to all weapon damage until the start of its next turn.

options.name: Sister’s Three
options.description: The Horror uses all three of the other effects at once, as part of the same bonus action.
